title: Nick Selector for Hypixel
description: Nick Selector is a helper tool which helps you select and use filters which will then automatically go thorugh the randomly selected nicks provided by Hypixels '/nick' system and pick out what you like :)
body:
### **⚠️ Disclaimer:** 

This mod can be considered to be a macro by some, so use this at your own risk.

Incompatibility with _some_ clients (Lunar Client).

**NickSelector** is the ultimate advanced Quality-of-Life (QoL) automation tool designed specifically for Hypixel players with the '/nick' feature unlocked. Stop wasting hours manually clicking and cycling through random, messy nick combinations. NickSelector uses an intelligent structural parser and local data dictionaries to automatically roll, scan, and secure the perfect nick **_for_** you.

# ✨ Key Features

* **High-Speed Smart Automator:** Keeps cycling your nickname via `/nick` commands smoothly, stopping the second a desirable nick is found.

* **Advanced Expression Engine:** Build custom expressions using powerful syntax criteria. Combine filters using **AND (`+`)**, **OR (`/`)**, bracketed grouping, and case-insensitivity toggles (e.g., `-(lily+free)-`). Note that this is completely optional, but can be used if you want a very specific nick :)

* **"AI" Trait-Based Scoring System:** Toggle or score specific filters. Grade nicknames automatically based on custom point weights for structure (letter count, capitalizations), sweat tags, or word categories.

* **Expansive Built-In Dictionaries:** Filters scan for real human names across multiple languages, alongside specific themes including *Nature, Mythology, Gemstones, PvP terms, Gaming, Flowers, and Aesthetic/Vibe words*.

* **Customizable HUD Overlay:** Track your metrics live! Monitor your active scan state, elapsed session time, rolling speed (**RPM**), and visual roll history on a draggable, real-time screen display.

* **Anti-Kick & AFK Protection:** Built-in network intelligence. If Hypixel sends you to Limbo or kicks you for message spam during a loop, NickSelector dynamically increments safety delays and automatically fires a `/lobby classic` response to get you right back to scanning. Lobby classic is used as a default fallback as it's one of the lobbies with least amount of players and won't lag you out. (this subject may be prone to changing)

* **Profile Manager & Nick Vault:** Store multiple saveable and loadable profiles to toggle configurations instantly. Godly nicks caught by the script are archived permanently into a personal clipboard-ready Nick Vault.

# 🎨 Visual Walkthrough & Customization

### Built-in Interactive Tutorial

New to expression syntax or scoring weights? No worries. NickSelector opens with a fully interactive, contextual tutorial box to walk you through your first target setup step-by-step.

### Beautiful Aesthetic UI Themes

Pick your style! Match your client's look with many preset themes (such as *Diamond, Amethyst, Sakura, Cyberpunk, and Royal*) or completely map your own look using the **Custom UI Creator** which also has an in-built colour picker.

# 🛠️ Commands & Configuration

Open the interface using the straightforward chat command console:

*   `/ns menu` - Opens the main configuration dashboard & trait-filtering control menu.
*   `/ns info` - Displays a menu with mod info.
*   `/ns hud` - Configures active UI attributes or launches the HUD layout drag tool.

### Sub-commands:

*   `/ns hud <drag/edit>` - Opens either of the hud sub-sections.

# ⌨️ Dynamic Hotkeys

**Toggle Key:** Instantly start or stop the automatic nick scanning loop.

**Continue Key:** Don't quite like a name that matched? Tap your custom hotkey to skip it manually and resume scanning immediately.

## 🔒 Safety & Integrity Notice

NickSelector operates locally on client-side compilation files and values your human profile limits. Always ensure your Base Delay (ms) configurations respect security to maintain a flow with server anti-spam filters.
